library_preparation_preflight.summary: micronaut-security-annotations:5.3.2 is a small marker-annotation jar (RUNTIME retention, no code-gen, no bound interceptor); its only compile deps (micronaut-inject/micronaut-aop) resolve transitively via the artifact itself, so the generated scaffold's testImplementation on the coordinate is sufficient. No Docker image, extra dependency, or env/system property is needed.
library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Test these annotations (@Secured, @RunAs, @CreatedBy, @UpdatedBy) via plain reflection on annotated classes/methods/fields (retention, target, declared values) — enforcement/interception logic lives in the separate io.micronaut.security:micronaut-security core artifact, not in this jar, so don't assume AOP interception or a running security filter is exercisable here. No testAnnotationProcessor is needed since these annotations are plain markers, not code-generating (unlike micronaut-sourcegen-annotations).
risks: The internal SecuredEvaluationContextRegistrar SPI class only participates in Micronaut's compile-time expression-evaluation processing when a consumer uses expression-style @Secured values; ordinary role-string usage won't exercise it, so it may end up with little or no direct coverage — that's expected given this artifact's scope.
